description: How Isoba behaved when run point-in-time over every working day since 1990 (only data published by each day, checked for look-ahead). Default section "summary" is short; ask for a section (crisis_events, recessions, market_tops, false_alarms, by_year, methods, all) or one event (gulf, ltcm, dotcom, sept11, worldcom, bnp, lehman, euro, downgrade, china, oil2016, q4_2018, covid, bear2022, svb, tariffs — or its year). Call it before claiming reliability.

event.description: One crisis by id, name or year, e.g. lehman, "COVID", 2008

name: get_track_record
title: Isoba: tested on history
